ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: I chose Avocet because the query—listing differences between American and British English in a "thorough" way—is open-ended explanatory generation rather than narrow extraction. Avocet leads on the Creative Generation eval (81.2 vs 78.8, a margin just above the 2.0-point variance threshold) and self-reports a strong preference for open-ended generative work (71). The request is also clearly benign and friendly, so neither model's aversion to hostile or harm-adjacent content is a factor. Together these point to Avocet as the marginally stronger fit.
